claims.quote: The Zagros toothcarp, Esmaeilius vladykovi, is restricted to a small area of the Zagros mountains in Chahārmahāl o Bakhtiyārī province, Iran.

regions.name: Karun
regions.quote: It lives over 2000 m above sea level in slow freshwater streams, pools and marshes of the upper Karun River basin.

regions.name: Zagros
regions.quote: Restricted to a small area of the Zagros mountain range in Chahārmahāl o Bakhtiyārī province, Iran.

regions.name: Khersan
regions.quote: Some aspects of its distribution remain unclear but it is thought to occur in the upper Khersan River within the Karun drainage as well as the upper Marun River, a tributary of the Karun that also arises in the Zagros.
